desc: Compute the frequency of each character in the string s.
Sort the frequencies in descending order to prioritize characters with higher counts.
Iterate over all possible target frequencies k from 1 to len(s).
For each k, iterate over the number of distinct characters m from 1 to min(26, len(s)//k + 1).
For each (k, m), calculate total_excess and total_deficit for the top m characters.
Compute the cost for (k, m) as max(total_excess, total_deficit) and update the global minimum.
Implement the solution by counting frequencies, sorting them, and iterating over k and m.
Edge cases: n=3, all same chars, all distinct.
